result.instructions: Tools for Spike.sh, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Spike.sh data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run spike_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spike_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spike_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. spike_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spike_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List all teams in the Spike.sh organization — {teams:[{_id, name, uid, private, org}]}. NOT team-scoped (no x-team-id needed). The `_id` values here are what you pass as `teamId` (x-team-id) to every other tool. Spike: GET /teams/get-all-teams.

tools.name: spike_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List incidents for a team — {incidents:[...], totalIncidents, totalOpenIncidents, pagination}. Each incident carries title, status, priority, severity, and timing. Spike: GET /incidents (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_list_triggered_incidents
tools.title: List triggered incidents
tools.description: List currently TRIGGERED (open, unacknowledged) incidents for a team — the active fire-fighting queue. Spike: GET /incidents/triggered (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_list_acknowledged_incidents
tools.title: List acknowledged incidents
tools.description: List currently ACKNOWLEDGED (being worked on, not yet resolved) incidents for a team. Spike: GET /incidents/acknowledged (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_get_incident
tools.title: Get incident
tools.description: Get a single incident's full detail by its counterId — {incident, duration, metadata, comments, repeatedIncidents}. Spike: GET /incidents/{counterId} (team-scoped).

counterId.description: The incident's counterId (its human-facing incident number/id).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_get_incident_activity_log
tools.title: Get incident activity log
tools.description: Get the chronological activity log for an incident — {incident, activities:[...]} (who acknowledged/resolved/commented and when). Spike: GET /incidents/{counterId}/activity-log (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_list_on_calls
tools.title: List on-call schedules
tools.description: List a team's on-call schedules — {oncalls:[...]}. Each on-call has an id, name, timezone, and layers. Use the id with spike_get_on_call / spike_who_is_on_call_next. Spike: GET /on-calls (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_get_on_call
tools.title: Get on-call schedule
tools.description: Get one on-call schedule by id — {oncall:{_id, name, timezone, teams, users, activeShift, renderedShifts}}. `from` optionally sets the window start for rendered shifts. Spike: GET /on-calls/{oncallId} (team-scoped).

from.description: ISO timestamp to render upcoming shifts from (e.g. "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z").

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_who_is_on_call_next
tools.title: Who is on call next
tools.description: Get the NEXT scheduled shift for an on-call schedule — {nextShift:{userId, startTimeInUTC, endTimeInUTC}} (or {} if none). Spike: GET /on-calls/{oncallId}/who-is-on-call-next (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.title: List escalation policies
tools.description: List a team's escalation policies — {totalEscalations, escalations:[{_id, name, teams, org}], pagination}. Spike: GET /escalations (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_get_escalation
tools.title: Get escalation policy
tools.description: Get one escalation policy by id — {escalation, integrations:[...], isPinned, alertRules}. Spike: GET /escalations/{escalationId} (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.title: List services
tools.description: List a team's services — {totalServices, services:[{_id, counterId, name, desc, teams, org}], pagination}. Spike: GET /services (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_get_service
tools.title: Get service
tools.description: Get one service by its counterId — {service, org, openIncidentsCountForService, incidents, badgeURL}. Spike: GET /services/{counterId} (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_acknowledge_incidents
tools.title: Acknowledge incidents
tools.description: ACKNOWLEDGES one or more incidents — this CHANGES live incident state (stops escalation and marks them as being worked on). Spike: POST /incidents/acknowledge with {ids:[...]}.

ids.description: Incident ids (the incident `_id` values) to acknowledge.

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_resolve_incidents
tools.title: Resolve incidents
tools.description: RESOLVES (closes) one or more incidents — this CHANGES live incident state and marks them done. Spike: POST /incidents/resolve with {ids:[...]}.

ids.description: Incident ids (the incident `_id` values) to resolve.

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

tools.name: spike_set_incident_priority
tools.title: Set incident priority
tools.description: Sets the PRIORITY (p1..p5) on one or more incidents — this CHANGES live incident state. Spike: POST /incidents/priority with {ids:[...], priority}.

ids.description: Incident ids (the incident `_id` values) to update.

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.
